question_text:
In an undirected graph, the nodes are numbered from 0 to 13, and every node has an embedding. (i,j) means that node i and node j are connected with an undirected edge.
Embeddings:
node 0: [0,0]
node 1: [0,0]
node 2: [0,1]
node 3: [0,0]
node 4: [1,0]
node 5: [0,1]
node 6: [0,1]
node 7: [1,0]
node 8: [1,0]
node 9: [1,1]
node 10: [0,0]
node 11: [1,1]
node 12: [1,1]
node 13: [1,1]
The edges are: (0,2) (0,1) (0,4) (1,7) (1,3) (2,6) (2,12) (2,4) (3,11) (3,10) (3,13) (3,4) (4,7) (4,10) (4,13) (5,6) (5,12) (6,9) (7,8) (8,9) (8,12) (9,13) (10,13)
In a simple graph convolution layer, each node's embedding is updated by the sum of its neighbors' embeddings.
Q: What's the embedding of each node after one layer of simple graph convolution layer?
A:

Return only a JSON object using this schema: {"node_embeddings":{"0":[0,0]}}. Do not output explanations.
